visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page banner over a muted, looping background video
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed autoplay background video with poster and pause control, left-aligned white text and two solid buttons

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: poster image and a link to the video file (.mp4/.webm). Row 2: optional logo image, heading, optional text, one or two CTA links
contentPattern.rationale: Full-bleed video/photo background with overlaid heading and CTAs is a hero; the background media belongs to the block, so the section is not colored.

usage: Top-of-page banner with a muted, looping background video (poster image shown first), optional logo image above the heading, a heading and up to two CTA buttons. Row 1: poster image and a link to the .mp4/.webm file. Row 2: logo image, heading, text, links.
reuseGuidance: Use when the banner background is a video. For a still photo with a dark gradient use hero-gradient.

blockContent.description: Background video with poster, FOAM logo image, H1, two CTA links

rows: Background image or video link (with poster image)
Optional eyebrow/logo image, heading, subheading paragraph, CTA links
structure.notes: Section 1 puts the poster image plus a link to https://www.cambriausa.com/content/dam/cusa/videos/launch-videos/ndl-summer-26/ndl-q3-2026-cusa-homepage-carousel-720p.mp4 in row 1; FOAM logo image above the H1 in row 2. Keep "Introducing NEW Cambria Quartz Surfaces" as H1 and "More to See, More to Savor" as H2.
